sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: By accessing or using VN SHOP, you agree to these Terms of Use. If you do not agree, please discontinue use of the website.

sections.heading: Website use
sections.text: You agree to use this website lawfully and not to interfere with its operation, security, availability, or content. You must not attempt to gain unauthorized access to accounts or systems.

sections.heading: Products and availability
sections.text: Product descriptions, images, prices, and availability may change without notice. A product displayed on the website is not a guarantee that it is currently available for purchase.

sections.heading: Accounts and security
sections.text: You are responsible for providing accurate information and keeping access to your email account secure. Verification codes are intended for your use only and should not be shared with others.

sections.heading: Intellectual property
sections.text: Website content, brand assets, logos, and original materials remain the property of their respective owners. They may not be copied, redistributed, or used commercially without permission.

sections.heading: Changes to these terms
sections.text: These terms may be updated when necessary. The current version published on this website applies to your use of the service.

sections.heading: Contact
sections.text: For questions about these terms, visit Help & Support.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: VN SHOP respects your privacy. This notice explains the main types of information that may be processed when you use the website.

sections.heading: Information you provide
sections.text: If you use account sign-in, your email address is processed to send a verification code and establish your account session. If you choose to receive updates from 9ojeez9, that preference may also be associated with the account sign-up request.

sections.heading: Authentication
sections.text: Account authentication is provided by Supabase. Your email address, verification requests, and authentication session are processed as needed to provide sign-in functionality. Never share a verification code with anyone.

sections.heading: Cookies and preferences
sections.text: The website stores your cookie preferences in your browser so that your selections can be remembered. You can review those choices using Cookie Choices in the website footer.

sections.heading: How information is used
sections.text: Information may be used to operate account features, maintain website security, remember your preferences, and provide features you request.

sections.heading: Third-party services
sections.text: The website relies on third-party services for functionality such as authentication and loading external resources. Those services may process technical data under their own terms and privacy notices.

sections.heading: Your choices
sections.text: You can choose whether to request account sign-in and whether to opt in to updates. You can also adjust your cookie preferences using Cookie Choices.

sections.heading: Contact
sections.text: For privacy questions, visit Help & Support. The full published policy is also available at Privacy Policy.
